consequence.statement: The enableCiliumEndpointSlice Helm option is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; existing deployments using this option should migrate to ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled.
consequence.remediation: Update Helm values to replace enableCiliumEndpointSlice with ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled.

original.statement: Helm option enableCiliumEndpointSlice has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release; use ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled instead.

decision.reason: [ev-79276bab0c0a] says the Helm option `enableCiliumEndpointSlice` "has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release" and has been replaced by `ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled`. It does not say the option stops working or is ignored in 1.16.0. That makes this a deprecation, which needs review, not mandatory work. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence, and [ev-28e0ccb5774a]/[ev-39a22d88e2f5] confirm the key still exists in the chart values.
